dt-1.problem: There are few options for profit and loss calculation tools that are compatible with multi-chains, including Cardano. In particular, there is no one that is compatible with the Japanese tax system.
dt-1.solution:
**【Crypto Accounting for Cardano】**

We will develop a web app that calculates P&L from a wallet address.

Features:

1. Retrieve transaction from wallet address.
2. Calculate P&L.
3. Output c

dt-2.problem: Organic adoption and development of dApps is too slow. Not only that but creating a startup is difficult and it is very likely to fail.
dt-2.solution: Milkomeda will be launching a second batch of its acceleration program together with SOSV (sosv.com) where companies will be coached.

dt-3.problem: Milkomeda allows moving native tokens <-> ERC20 tokens between Cardano and Milkomeda, but does not support ERC721 or ERC1155 (ex: NFTs)
dt-3.solution: Build infrastructure required to be able to bring NFTs or ERC1155-compatible assets between Cardano <-> Milkomeda

dt-4.problem: Currently there is no way for users to run Cardano smart contracts from a mobile device
dt-4.solution: We want to allow users to use Milkomeda smart contracts from their mobile device

dt-5.problem: Cardano uses a encoding scheme called CBOR that supports multiple ways of encoding the same data. No Rust library supports all possible encodings of data which has caused multiple critical issues
dt-5.solution: We will implement support in the cddl-codgen for generating Rust code that supports multiple CBOR encoding possibilities to ensure reliability of the Rust-based Cardano tool stack

dt-6.problem: To ensure decentralization, we need to make it easy for users and developers to run full node and archive nodes of Milkomeda
dt-6.solution: We will provide an easy to run docker solution so that users and developers can easily run their own full nodes and/or archive nodes

dt-7.problem: Many projects rely on an IOHK tool called cardano-db-sync. This means that when an issue is found in db-sync, the many projects are affected
dt-7.solution: We will write an alternative to cardano-db-sync in Rust powered by Oura starting with the core functionality needed for light wallets.

dt-8.problem: Indonesians receive an average of 14+ spam calls per month, partly due to unprotected digital verification, while developers struggle with the cost and security risks of managing phone databases.
dt-8.solution: Midnight Shield replaces SMS OTPs with ZK Proofs. Verify your phone once to mint a credential, then login anonymously. Stops spam by proving unique humanity without sharing data.

dt-9.problem: Projects on Cardano lack an **Ecosystem Building Blueprint** for entering jurisdictions and ensuring the successful implementation of **national-level solutions.**
dt-9.solution: Beginning with the **Global Speciality Tea Sector** as our case study, we will deliver a systematic playbook and **Ecosystem Building Blueprint** to successfully deploy national-level solutions.

dt-10.problem: Currently no efficient tooling exists for storing the blocks persistently with fast indexing and fast distribution. For example, an empty indexer on Oura will still take ~300s/epoch
dt-10.solution: We introduce new thread-safe memory-efficient persistent storage with indexing capabilities. Using a single-file solution, there will be no extra processing overhead for download and synchronization.

dt-11.problem:
To reduce the noise to society caused by data whose authenticity cannot be proven


-data can be super easily modified and processed by AI-

dt-12.problem: The memory of RaspberryPi4 is 8GB and a spec of about 16GB is required. It contains unnecessary features and needs further optimization.
dt-12.solution: We will develop hardware dedicated to stake pool operators that can be powered by small, eco-friendly power such as an enhanced RaspberryPi4

dt-13.problem: Cardano needs a wallet with robust handling of multisig for enterprise use cases and for DAOs
dt-13.solution: We will deploy Gnosis Safe on Milkomeda and deploy a UI for it for ease-of-use

dt-14.problem: As transactions increase on the Cardano network, every node cannot relay every message utilizing the current TCP/IP architecture.
dt-14.solution: Deploy a proof of concept stake pool and relay solution of Ouroborus over RINA using Ethernet/WDM at two sites in Tokyo, Japan.

dt-15.problem: zk-rollups using validity proofs are currently the most likely solutions that will help scale up blockchains. Cardano is missing this so far
dt-15.solution: Research and clear blueprint on how to implement zk-rollups on top of Milkomeda as a L3 as well as a roadmap for wallet implementation

dt-16.problem: Fracada is a fractionalized NFT project for Cardano. It was audited thanks to a Catalyst proposal in the previous round and now we need funds to implement the audit
dt-16.solution: The funds will be used for a Plutus developer to address the concerns found in the audit, followed by publishing the audit and updated code for the community

dt-17.problem: Currently Sebastien (dcSpark CTO) acts as a Catalyst editor which requires a weekly time commitment. This proposal is to cover the time cost
dt-17.solution: Financially cover the time cost of having Sebastien act as a CIP editor which involves both reviewing & writing proposals

dt-18.problem: Indexers are a core component of DeFi and one popular indexer protocol is called TheGraph. We need a project like this in Cardano
dt-18.solution: We will deploy an instance of TheGraph to Milkomeda which will act as an indexing protocol for querying networks like Milkomeda and IPFS

dt-19.problem: Currently one of the hard problems in the blockchain space is discovery. Difficulty in finding dApps lowers user engagement and fuels FUD
dt-19.solution: We will build a dApp store for Milkomeda so that users can see all the apps in the Cardano ecosystem that are deployed on Milkomeda

dt-20.problem: Cardano-serialization-lib is one of the top projects in the ecosystem used by almost all dApps & needs to be updated for the next hardfork
dt-20.solution: dcSpark will make the required changes to cardano-serialization-lib to update it for the Babbage hardfork

dt-21.problem: Creating secure and efficient smart contracts from scratch on a new blockchain like Midnight can lead to vulnerabilities, inefficiencies, and longer development times.
dt-21.solution: We offer a secure library of smart contracts for Midnight, which includes basic contract implementations. This library will enhance security, reduce development costs, and speed up project deployment.

is-1.problem: Mental health care suffers from low participation due to stigma and privacy fears, creating barriers in research recruitment treatment access, and care continuity.
is-1.solution: Mental health participation increases through anonymous SSI credentials on Cardano, enabling stigma-free screening, treatment access, and research participation with token rewards.

is-3.solution: The Aizu lab in Japan will study the use of Cardano's Atala DID as an ID on the metaverse.

is-4.problem: RealFi projects like Landano need decentralized solutions for identity and credentials which can be used by users globally. However, system requirements and available solutions aren’t yet understood.
is-4.solution: Landano will research DID use cases and analyze pilot user feedback to prepare formal software requirements for a DID component and provide an evaluation on how Cardano solutions meet these needs.

is-5.problem: Atala should be accessible to everyone. However, it is not integrated with Milkomeda and is affecting the adoption of Atala and Milkomeda. 日本語
is-5.solution: We integrate Atala to Milkomeda via ProofSpace/Socious to increase the adoption of Cardano.

is-6.problem: In Japan, solutions in the society and the industry using Japan national IDs is not popular yet.

is-7.problem: The Prism wallet SDK doesn't currently have the ability to store DIDs and credentials. This means that current users of the SDK have to build their own identity storage impacting on Cardano adoption.
is-7.solution: The project objective will work with other ecosystem projects to develop an adaptable storage implementation that supports early adoption and Cardano onboarding.

is-8.problem: There is no impact score system that visualizes and attributes social & environmental impact to decentralized identities.日本語
is-8.solution: Socious uses Atala PRISM/ProofSpace to attribute “impact score” to visualize users' contributions to impact projects and reward them with crypto tokens, which increases utility & adoption of Cardano.

is-9.problem: There is no team to deal with Japanese SCAM and FUD (ADA is gambling coin etc.).
is-9.solution: We will create a team to deal with Japanese SCAM and FUD (ADA is gambling coin etc.) and deal with it as much as possible.

is-10.problem: According to a [survey](https://www.entrepreneur.com/business-news/more-than-half-of-americans-say-they-lie-on-their-resumes/441589), 55% of respondents admitted to lying on their resumes. Unfortunate
is-10.solution: Build a Dapp to record work history as verifiable credentials and publish a Governance Framework, enabling hiring organizations to verify the authenticity of work history to hire qualified candidates.

is-11.problem: Currently, there is no open-source identity wallet available that supports both browser and mobile platforms and is compatible with Atala PRISM v2.0.
is-11.solution: We will create an open-source identity wallet compatible with Atala PRISM v2.0. The wallet can issue and verify academic and other certificates.

is-12.problem: The reliance on seed phrase-based wallet recovery and the lack of No-Code Self-Sovereign Identity solutions are hindering mass adoption. [日本語](https://youtu.be/sYkCgAFngk0)
is-12.solution: We improve the Atala identity wallet SDK to allow wallet recovery using a password-protected backup file instead of a seed phrase. We also build a no-code Self-Sovereign Identity platform.

df-1.problem: Farming incentives have proven to be very effective in crypto. We can use this to incentivize projects to move liquidity from Ethereum
df-1.solution: We will use funds to provide a farming incentive to users that move liquidity from Ethereum to Cardano

df-2.problem: Although we need to encourage moving computation to L2s to scale, currently doing so will cause you to lose your staking rewards making it hard to convince users to migrate
df-2.solution: We will design & implement a standard for Milkomeda to allow its users to keep earning staking rewards. We will share the approach publicly so other L2s / sidechains can implement their own variation

df-3.problem: Direct contracts between employers and remote developers may lead to disputes. However, centralized escrow services can be expensive and their decisions may be arbitrary. 日本語
df-3.solution: Decentralized escrow to protect both remote developers and hiring organizations with cheaper fees and a fair/decentralized dispute settlement mechanism.

df-4.problem: Djed, the stablecoin protocol, does not require the UTXO model and can also be deployed on accounting (ex: EVM) blockchains too well. This may help users & devs understanding and bring new ideas.
df-4.solution: Our team developed and deployed Djed for the *testnet* version of Milkomeda. This allowed both developers and users to play around with Djed before its official release on Cardano.

df-5.problem: Most Crypto dApps require liquidity to work correctly. Low liquidity implies jumps in prices, lack of tokens among other undesirable things.
df-5.solution: Bridge liquidity for top protocols. The liquidity will be permanent on those protocols so dcSpark won't be getting any direct commission.

df-6.problem: Financial services for 1.7 billion adults who are unbanked are limited. Microfinance’s interest rate (global average: 35%) is much higher than that of bank credit (10.31%). 日本語
df-6.solution: A P2P lending platform with low interest rates for the unbanked, powered by Impact Score instead of credit history.

df-7.problem: Currently wallets in Cardano cannot easily display prices of native tokens on Cardano through self-hosted solutions
df-7.solution: We will deploy an Oura source+sink that parses on-chain dApp data to provide an open-source self-hosted price feed that wallets can use

df-8.problem: Most of Cardano's Defi is in English. ADA held by the Japanese is huge.It is necessary to encourage the participation of Japanese people.
df-8.solution: Introduce 100 briefly and 10 in detail about Defi in Japanese.

df-9.problem: Many contribute their time to impact projects but their contributions are not well recognized or rewarded. This also discourages some people to contribute their time to social/environmental causes.日本語
df-9.solution: We attribute “impact score” to volunteers/freelancers who contribute their time to impact projects (valuation). Users receive THANK tokens proportional to their impact score (monetization).

df-10.problem: Current business transactions suffer from issues of insecurity, exclusion, high costs, and lack of anonymity, primarily caused by centralized intermediaries and the absence of decentralization.
df-10.solution: Create decentralized escrow and dispute resolution on blockchain for secure, inclusive, cost-effective transactions, tackling issues caused by centralized intermediaries and lack of decentralization

ed-11.solution: To promote Cardano's merits and facilitate its adoption, we will launch a dedicated Crypto Magazine that highlights Cardano and provides comparative analysis with other major blockchains

gv-1.problem: In Japan, the government is moving toward legalization of LLC-type DAO legal entities. Therefore, we will establish effective use cases to work in the sandbox ahead of the legislation.
gv-1.solution:
Tax Deductible Donations by Direct Donation of Crypto Assets

Staking operations with donated crypto assets

Introduction of a voting system in the distribution of treasury

gv-2.problem: Help shaping regulations in a way that support the industry and Cardano.
gv-2.solution: Participating with the Chamber of Digital Commerce will help us interacting with regulators and other key players in the industry.

gv-4.problem: Referral fraud poses a significant challenge for the growth of DAOs, accounting for [21% of all attacks,](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1297428/leading-fraud-attacks-online-merchants-worldwide/)
gv-4.solution: A decentralized referral system that utilizes smart contracts, guaranteeing security and transparency. By combating referral fraud, the system facilitates DAO’s growth and fosters a thriving community

gv-5.problem: There is no comprehensive survey of Japanese law and no organization to oppose some of the reported excesses of the legal system.
gv-5.solution: A Comprehensive Survey of Japanese Law + Send at least two letters of opposition to excessive legal systems

gv-6.problem: Existing crowdfunding platforms [favor a few wealthy individuals](https://cointelegraph.com/explained/quadratic-funding-the-future-of-crowdfunding-explained), neglecting community voices. They lack de
gv-6.solution: Extended quadratic funding combines modest contributions from individuals who have done good deeds with larger matching sums. This approach promotes fair and inclusive funding for public goods.

gv-7.problem: Cardano lacks tools to show how different funding strategies and ADA’s volatility affect treasury risk, leaving voters and DReps without quantitative support for resilient funding decisions.
gv-7.solution: Photrek builds a treasury risk analyst using coupled-entropy to evaluate funding strategies via scenario forecasts and risk metrics, guiding treasury decisions impacted by currency volatility.

gv-8.problem: Project Catalyst, as a decentralized innovation fund, is still highly dependent on the IOG for the operation and further development of the platform.
gv-8.solution: We offer the community an alternative that makes Project Catalyst a purely decentralized innovation fund by acting as a transition from an IOG-led Project Catalyst to a Project Catalyst DAO.

rw-2.problem: In order to implement offline authentication using broadcasting (IPDC) and blockchain as a service, it is very important to be able to demonstrate it using actual television broadcasting radio waves.
rw-2.solution: The innovative system that combines broadcast waves (IPDC) and CARDANO to enable offline verification of certificates even in situations where the Internet is unavailable, such as during a disaster.

rw-3.problem: Japan’s municipalities lack economic independence. Expanding Symons’ Web2 model into a points and crypto platform can make them players in a decentralized economy, advancing government and tourism DX.
rw-3.solution: We will evolve Symons’ Web2 model into a Cardano L1 + Hydra blockchain platform, integrating points and cryptocurrency to enable municipal autonomy and support comprehensive government and tourism DX.

rw-4.solution: Build a Real World Asset launchpad using IOT technology, enabling access to the finance system for these people and distributing interest to the investors who support them.

rw-5.problem: Grow an ecosystem is hard even harder is doing it in a speedy manner. Some startups that are already in Ethereum need convincing and mentoring to join the ecosystem and growth fast.
rw-5.solution: A 4-6 week acceleration program in partnership with SOSV (one of the most active early stage investors in the US) that scout, attract, support, guide and fund startups with high potential of growth.

rw-6.problem: WalletConnect is a standard to connect mobile wallets to desktop dApps without having the private key leave the mobile app. It is integrated by many dApps, but does not support Cardano currently
rw-6.solution: We will do the required engineering work to add WalletConnect support to FlintWallet and write information about how any other wallet in the Cardano ecosystem that has a mobile app can add support too

rw-7.solution: The proposed solution is a digital platform that uses the immutability and reliability of the Cardano blockchain to safely and permanently pass on personal thoughts and memories to the future.

rw-9.problem: Web3, including DAOs, is gaining attention in Japan as a solution to issues like the declining birthrate and aging population. However, neither the apps nor society are ready for such implementations.
rw-9.solution: Develop a major social implementation case study in Takamatsu City, Shikoku, using Cardano-based Dapps and DAOs to solve social problems in Japan, integrating real communities for impactful solutions.

rw-10.problem: Lack of liquidity for physical assets in rural areas is a big issue for revitalization of local economies. ANGO is creating a platform for RWA DAO projects to raise money to utilize local assets.
rw-10.solution: Provide tool for issuing and exchange tokens of RWA DAOs to provide money and liquidity to social conscious projects that otherwise would not have started. Help the projects to get funding and users.

rw-11.problem: The use case  for non Crypto citizens is important.  For understanding Cardano worth, we have to emphasize the benefit from Cardano Project.
rw-11.solution: The special discount on internet shopping by ADA supported by Catalyst will promote ADA holder shopping and active local area economy.

rw-12.problem: There is no tool that allows you to cut out portions of an artist's live & sell it as an NFT during the show, it'll be good recruitment tool
rw-12.solution: Tool that allows owner to cut out portions of an artist's live & sell it as NFT during the show in Cardano would be a good recruitment tool.

io-1.problem: Adoption with businesses and enterprise solutions with Cardano is difficult and there is no a good platform to get traction and adoption.
io-1.solution: Cotalker integration will allow companies to use Cardano as a source of true for storing operational information that can be verified.

io-2.problem: Prove reserves, identity, delegating to a pool and more.

io-3.problem: Milkomeda is a sidechain so traceability of wrapping and unwrapping is really difficult because block explorers only work on one side.
io-3.solution: Milkomeda token bridge explorer will allow to do full traceability of assets when they move from one chain to the other one.

gf-1.problem: The absence of practical adoption examples poses a significant challenge for the Cardano system. Developing a viable product based on real-world applications is imperative for sustained profitability.
gf-1.solution: We are set to develop a novel sports funding application for "FC Tokushima," the football team, utilizing the Cardano chain and CNFTs. The application will incorporate a robust CNFT and token system.

gf-2.problem: Gaming is one of the fastest growing categories in crypto. Cardano is not quite there in terms of quantity of games.
gf-2.solution: Milkomeda Game will be a simple casual game that uses blockchain concepts. It will bring adoption and usage to Cardano through Milkomeda.

gf-3.problem: Currently, most blockchain-based games are not actually running on-chain. Instead, they run on centralized servers and the only blockchain component are NFTs and tokens used by the game
gf-3.solution: We will make a 2nd game for Milkomeda that operates entirely on-chain without needing to trust a centralized server, and do so in a more gas-friendly way than traditional gas-hungry on-chain games

nf-1.problem: Despite the great value of artistic collections, especially fashion collections, they are not adequately preserved and the originals continue to be lost because of the enormous cost of preserving.
nf-1.solution: Making precise 3D scans of masterpieces and leave detailed 3D models for the future. By mixing the XR and blockchain technology, we'll incentivise collectors to preserve master peaces the right way.

nf-4.solution: The FOMUS Masu Photo Project is a global initiative that combines traditional Japanese craftsmanship with Cardano techniques to raise awareness of Cardano, publicize NFT, and expand the community.

su-2.solution: By activating microorganisms in the soil, organic agricultural products can be grown without using chemicals. And by utilizing the blockchain, the traceability of foodstuffs can be guaranteed.

su-3.solution: Measure and visualize CO2 emissions associated with coffee production. Design a mechanism to increase the creditworthiness and incentives of producers in Africa by reducing CO2 emissions.

sc-1.problem: Multiple bridges connected to Milkomeda and Cardano result in the creation of multiple assets (derivatives) which fragment liquidity (of the same asset e.g. USDC) and impact UX in protocols.
sc-1.solution: The creation of a canonical smart contract where whitelisted assets (and bridges) can exchange their bridged asset by a canonical version that will be used by the Cardano ecosystem.
